rows.findingAndDisposition: Labels name visible line structures in three original samples, not a mark for personal taste. The pupil tests and chooses a challenge using their own baseline.
The ordering is a stated thumbnail-test method with an intention, two real sketches, comparison and next decision. It does not prescribe everyone’s action plan.
The hatching prediction names what stays similar. A multiple-change comparison does not isolate spacing. Actual samples are kept even when they differ from the prediction.
Error repairs keep artistic observation, personal creative impact and actual sharing distinct. A saved draft is not a received review; actual audience attendance remains required.
The five research strands keep first-hand encounter, organisation, education, career and personal influence separate. Every card is an example; a possible route is not a guarantee.
An informal compliment does not automatically review the challenge. Both real reviews and their locations remain separate; exact scribing supports rather than replaces the pupil’s view.
The original sketch is judged against its explicit whole-image/separate-caption aim, not a universal design rule. The pupil still chooses an actual project and agrees an identifiable role.
Five planning areas remain present. Draft promotion, intended recruitment and planned feedback are not falsely described as completed actions. Checks name who must agree the real setup.
Letter size is a prediction to test with the real collaborator, not a promise of access or understanding. A no-change response is retained and simultaneous changes limit causal claims.
Error checks distinguish planned from actual participation and arts outcomes from leadership evidence. Support leaves participant choices intact and real delivery is required.
A pause has no invented personal explanation. The leader asks about the task, checks a response and can retain a working method with a reason. No complaint is manufactured.
The specified small shared task proceeds from listening and agreed roles to actual contribution and joint checking. The ongoing independent task remains flexible and needs real collaboration.
The stated example separates a supported judgement, actual feedback/action evidence and a future step. One person’s reply does not establish whole-group learning.
The original map contains all nine exact parts in two units. It distinguishes 1B, 2C and 2E, requires checking all nine actual locators and preserves the existing twenty-file cap.
